pacchato.p: [Pacchā+to] (bya) Google Translate R. 265. Niti, Sutta. See Niroti. 277-8.] (1) Back. (2) After. (3) After. (4) After (Khandha).

B:
pacchato： pacchato（bya）
ပစ္ဆတော（ဗျ）
[pacchā+to．rū．265．nīti，sutta．493．nirutti．277-8．]
[ပစ္ဆာ+တော။ ရူ။၂၆၅။ နီတိ၊သုတ္တ။၄၉၃။ နိရုတ္တိ။၂၇၇-၈တို့ကြည့်။]
P: Pacchato，（adv．） [Abl．formation fr．*paccha=Ved．paścā & paścāt，fr．Idg．*pos as in Lith．pàs near by，pastaras the last； cp．Av．pasca behind，Lat．post，after] behind，after Dh．348 （=anāgatesu khandhesu DhA．IV，63； opp．pure）； PvA．56，74； DhA．III，197 （°vatti）．Often doubled pacchato pacchato，i．e．always or close behind，J．II，123 （opp．purato purato）．-- Cp．pacchā & pacchima．（Page 386）
R:
pacchato：ပစ္ဆတော （နိ）
နောက်မှ။
ပစ္ဆတော ပစ္ဆတော ဂမိဿာမိ၊ နောက်မှ နောက်မှ လိုက်အံ့။
DOP: pacchato ind. [paccha + to; BHS paścato (Uv 29:57); cf S. paśca, paścāt], 1. ( adv. and prep. + gen. ) behind; after; Vin IV 150, 30 (~ato gacchanto turito gacchati sossāmī ti); 185, 4 (chabbaggiyā bhikkhū purato pi ~ato pi olambentā nivāsenti); S V 351, 8 (tā ekaṃ purato ekaṃ ~ato nisīdāpema); A III 344, 11 (addhānamaggapaṭipanno na kañci passāmi purato vā ~ato vā); IV 190, 25 (~ato paṭisakkati); Dhp 348 (muñca pure muñca ~ato; Dhp-a IV 63, 3 foll.: anāgatesu pi khandhesu ālayādīni muñca); Pv 38:5 (purato dissati maggo ~ato ca na dissati); Th 309 (mahāleṇassa ~ato; Th-a II 131, 23 : pacchābhāge); 537 (purato ~ato vā pi aparo ca na vijjati atīva phāsu bhavati ekassa vasato vane); Ja I 98, 24 (dvīhi amhehi ekato gantuṃ na sakkā, kiṃ tvaṃ purato gamissasi udāhu ~ato ti); 397, 12 (bodhisattassa ~ato ~ato agamāsi); III 480, 20* (~ato tuyha naṅguṭṭhaṃ); V 321, 25´ (bodhisattassa mātā pana tassa ~ato nīcatare āsane nisīdi); VI 313, 23* (so Puṇṇako Kurunaṃ kattuseṭṭhaṃ nisīdayī ~ato āsanasmiṃ); 332, 15 (itare dārakā ~ato dhāvantā); Ap 24, 24 (piṇḍacāraṃ carantassa ~ato agamās’ ahaṃ); Mil 24, 8 (Milindo rājā sabbaṃ taṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ purato ca ~ato ca majjhato ca anuvilokento); Vism 403, 28 (bhagavantaṃ disvā … ~ato āgacchantaṃ pana theraṃ disvā); Sp 73, 4 (Asokassa puttā … rajjaṃ kāresuṃ, tesaṃ ~ato nava Nandā dvevīsatim eva); Sv 210, 17 (pacchābhattan ti bhattassa ~ato); Mp I 166, 16 (rājā dhammāsanassa ~ato antosāṇiyaṃ nisinno dhammaṃ suṇāti); Dhp-a III 197, 18 (koci eko kileso pi loke ~ato vattī nāma na hoti nānubandhatī ti, Be, Ce so; Ee vatti; Se nivatti; cf S. paścādvartin); As 120, 8 (mama ~ato etha, mā bhayitthā ti); Mhv 14:43 (nārohāma rathaṃ gaccha gacchāma tava ~ato); — 2. to the west; S IV 189, 11 (tassa purato pi kaṇṭako ~ato pi kaṇṭako uttarato pi kaṇṭako dakkhiṇato pi kaṇṭako); Ja V 255, 18* (na ~ato na purato n’ uttaraṃ no pi dakkhiṇaṃ); 266, 29* (puratthimena dhāvanti tato dhāvanti ~ato) = Nidd I 405, 26* ; Ja VI 278, 15* (purato Videhe passa Goyāniye ca ~ato); — apacchatopavattika, mfn. , not turning backwards; As 233, 14 (taṃ apacchatopavattikaṃ katvā, Be, Ce so; Se apacchatopavattiyaṃ; Ee na apacchato pavattitaṃ, prob. wr ); — see also pacchā 2 .

pacchātāpa：ပစ္ဆာတာပ（ပု）
[ပစ္ဆာ+တပ+ဏ]
နောက်၌ ပူပန်ခြင်း၊ နောင်တ တဖန်-စိုးရိမ်-ပူပန်-ခြင်း၊ နှလုံးမသာယာခြင်း၊ စိတ်မချမ်းသာခြင်း၊ နောင်တ တဖန်-စိုးရိမ်-ပူပန်-ကြောင်းတရား။
